a0.yes: Creates an early-term vacancy election process and changes legislative leadership pay and travel approval.
a0.context: PARCA highlights the Legislature’s ability to set leadership pay without a gubernatorial veto.

a1.yes: Creates a process for neighboring county school systems to merge, with an impact study and protest-triggered referendum.
a1.context: PARCA stresses that passage would not itself merge any systems.

a2.yes: Requires school-board policies for a daily Pledge and student-led prayer, with opt-outs.
a2.no: Does not add these constitutional mandates.
a2.context: PARCA notes existing state provisions and constitutional limits on school-sponsored prayer.

a3.yes: Requires a weekly broadcast or performance of the anthem’s first stanza in public K–12 schools.
a3.no: Leaves the constitution without this requirement.
a3.context: PARCA notes that students cannot be compelled to participate in patriotic exercises.

a4.yes: Extends PSC oversight to certain private sewer systems using public road rights-of-way, subject to the amendment’s conditions.
a4.no: Does not add this authority through the amendment.
a4.context: PARCA’s local guide covers this Madison County measure; the statewide guide covers amendments 1–4.
